PZZ700-142200-
212 AM PDT Wed Oct 14 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1026 mb high was around 300 nautical miles west of Cape
Mendocino, a 1025 mb high was over central Nevada, and a 1010 mb 
low covered the southern Gulf of California. Weak offshore flow 
during nights and mornings will alternate with northwest onshore 
flow during afternoons and evenings through Thursday. Offshore 
flow will begin to prevail and strengthen late Thursday, and peak
Friday into Saturday. Isolated northeast gusts could exceed 20
knots Friday into early Saturday. Onshore northwest flow returns 
later Saturday, alternating with weak offshore flow during the 
night and morning through Sunday.
